notes:
1. 将程序版本号更新至 1.5.7。
2. 游戏运行期间暂停定时备份和文件变动备份，退出并等待存档稳定后合并执行，避免存档冲突和动态文件名导致的读取失败。[#21](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/21)
3. 新增每个游戏独立的定时备份、文件监控备份和退出后备份开关。[#22](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/22)
4. 自动备份进程检测不再依赖云同步或云端目录，并补充推迟、稳定等待、重试和完成活动日志。[#21](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/21)
5. Bump the application version to 1.5.7.
6. Defer scheduled and file-change backups while a game is running, then create one backup after exit and save stabilization to prevent conflicts and failures caused by changing filenames. [#21](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/21)
7. Add independent per-game controls for scheduled, file-change, and game-exit backups. [#22](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/22)
8. Decouple automatic-backup process detection from cloud sync and cloud folders, with activity logs for deferral, stabilization, retries, and completion. [#21](https://github.com/Kiowx/save_manager/issues/21)
